state:
Goal `core-signal-and-4-more` is met. All five stage-2 checks pass: `Core\Signal`, `Core\Signature`,
`Core\SignedCookie`, `Core\Socket` and `Core\Socket\Message` owe nothing, and `bun nv verify --doc`,
`bun nv owners --closes` and `bun nv playbook --closes` are clean.
`Core\Socket::upgrade` has `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench. They run through
`nvs run --request <file>.nvsr --peer <file>.nvsp`: a request file whose `Upgrade` header names
`websocket` is offered the upgrade slot, and the prepared connection runs over the scripted peer once
the request ends (`crates/nvs-cli/src/peer.rs`'s module doc § *Beside `--request`*).
Its attack found a use-after-free in the method entry form (`Chat::run(...)`), in the server as well
as the CLI. It is fixed, and `a_method_entry_still_runs_after_the_request_releases_its_callable` pins it.

next.note: None: the goal is met, and the next goal on the chain starts from its own handoff.

backlog: A connection's `echo` output reaches standard output after every `sent:` line, because it is `Output::Inherit`'s. `crates/nvs-cli/src/peer.rs` `connect` documents it.
